# Bloub attribution

The animation engine in this directory is adapted from
[`jeremy-prt/bloub`](https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub), an MIT-licensed SVG recreation of the
x.ai bot avatar. The original copyright and license are preserved in `LICENSE`.

Only the framework-independent TypeScript engine is vendored. Thally provides its own React renderer,
product states and integration. The upstream project notes that its MIT license covers the code, not
the third-party visual identity it studies; this implementation is therefore suitable as a prototype
reference and must receive a distinct Thally silhouette before production branding is finalized.
